fusions.name: Drifting Spores
fusions.desc: Releases a cone of spores 5 tiles long that deals 10 damage to everything in it, with a 60% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it, and you heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Reaped Rot
fusions.desc: A cut at the root that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Fruiting Bodies
fusions.desc: Spores take every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Rich Mulch
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you regain 2 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
